title: IL-Property-ML: A unified structure-based framework for honest, IL-disjoint prediction of ionic-liquid properties
description: Assembled multi-property ionic-liquid database (11,511 records; 1,658 ion pairs), structure-based ML pipeline (MLR/GBM/MLP with RDKit descriptors + Morgan fingerprints), IL-disjoint validation results, SHAP analysis, figures, and manuscript for the associated Science submission.
